changelog:
Initial release of byted-sol-douyin-creator-upload:

- Upload local video files to Douyin Creator Center and publish, with options for visibility (public, friends, self) and description.
- Automates uploading, description filling, visibility selection, and publishing via existing logged-in Chrome browser session.
- Requires remote-debugging-enabled Chrome and existing Douyin Creator login.
- Supports parameterized CLI for file path, visibility, title, publish toggle, and CDP endpoint.
- Provides clear logs, robust error handling, and step reporting.
